findings.interpretation: An interactive session of the domain account tdungan on rd01 mapped drive H: to the Users folder of another host's administrative C$ share. Mapping C$ requires administrative rights on 172.16.6.12 and is a common lateral-movement and data-access step; it is also routine for administrators. The memory image shows the command, not whether the mapping succeeded or what was accessed.
findings.observation: In rd01 memory, windows.pstree shows explorer.exe (PID 6664, session 2) started cmd.exe (PID 6784) at 2023-01-25 14:52:04 UTC with the command line 'C:\Windows\system32\cmd.exe /C net use H: \\172.16.6.12\c$\Users', which started net.exe (PID 9128) with 'net  use H: \\172.16.6.12\c$\Users' at the same second. windows.getsids for PID 6784 lists S-1-5-21-2838623409-1327563992-2591358621-1136 tdungan, BUILTIN\Remote Desktop Users and Interactive, at Medium Mandatory Level.
findings.title: rd01: user tdungan mapped the C$ admin share of 172.16.6.12 (net use H: \\172.16.6.12\c$\Users) at 14:52:04 UTC

findings.interpretation: rd01 (172.16.6.11) was a hub of interactive and administrative remote access at capture time: someone was connected to it over RDP from 172.16.30.23 while its explorer.exe held an RDP session onward to 172.16.7.15, and it held SMB sessions both ways. Together with the C$ mapping (F-steve-001) this fits hands-on-keyboard lateral movement, but RDP, SMB and WinRM are also normal administration; the connections alone don't show intent.
findings.observation: windows.netscan on rd01 memory lists, among 170 entries: an inbound RDP connection 172.16.30.23:55264 -> 172.16.6.11:3389 ESTABLISHED (svchost.exe PID 960, TermService) created 14:38:47 UTC; an outbound RDP connection from explorer.exe (PID 6664) 172.16.6.11:59665 -> 172.16.7.15:3389 ESTABLISHED created 14:47:21 UTC; SMB 172.16.6.11:61814 -> 172.16.6.14:445 ESTABLISHED (System) created 14:54:00 UTC; inbound SMB 172.16.6.18:63026 -> 172.16.6.11:445 ESTABLISHED created 14:43:02 UTC; WinRM 172.16.6.11:54867 -> 172.16.5.21:5985 ESTABLISHED (svchost.exe PID 3300, WinRM) created 15:24:11 UTC.
findings.title: rd01 memory: live RDP, SMB and WinRM sessions to and from five internal hosts at capture time (172.16.30.23, 172.16.7.15, 172.16.6.14, 172.16.6.18, 172.16.5.21)
